subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
A synchronous counter is designed using D-FFs that 
generate sequence 0 – 3 – 1 – 2 – 0. FFs used have 
delay of td = 45 nsec and logic gatees used has zero 
delay, then maximum clock frequency that can be 
used to have proper operation of the circuit is 
________ MHz. 
[MCQ]
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-12 (Sequential Circuits (Part-5)).
